name: Create or Destroy Water
material: A drop of water to create, or a few grains of sand to destroy
description: Create up to 10 gallons of clean water in an open container or as rain in a 30-foot cube, or destroy up to 10 gallons of water or fog in a 30-foot cube.
at_higher_levels: Create or destroy 10 more gallons per slot level above 1; the cube grows by 5 feet per level.
